stories.title: Lighter loses $15.5 million in sudden drain, blames single API leak
stories.summary: Trading platform Lighter lost $15.5 million in a sudden drain of funds. The platform says a single leaked API key caused the incident. CryptoSlate reported the news on November 16.
stories.whyItMatters: Incidents like this erode trust in trading platforms and can trigger withdrawal halts or direct user losses.
whatToWatch: Lighter's full incident report on the root cause
Whether Lighter compensates affected users
Any on-chain tracing of the stolen funds
questions: Who held the leaked API key, and how was it exposed?

sources.title: Lighter loses $15.5M in sudden drain and blames a single API leak

stories.title: XRP's proposed upgrade could improve trading, but may not boost token demand
stories.summary: A proposed upgrade to XRP aims to improve trading on the network. Analysts say the change may not increase demand for the token itself. CryptoSlate covered the proposal on November 16.
stories.whyItMatters: Technical upgrades do not always translate into price support, a distinction holders should weigh.
whatToWatch: Formal proposal details and a vote or implementation timeline
Market reaction once the full upgrade specifics are public
questions: What exactly does the upgrade change technically?
Who proposed it, and when might it go live?

sources.title: XRP’s proposed upgrade could improve trading without boosting token demand

stories.title: Bitcoin's recovery signal looks false as $64 billion in futures activity masks weak demand
stories.summary: Bitcoin showed signs of recovery, but the bounce appears driven by heavy futures trading rather than real buying. CryptoSlate reports about $64 billion in futures activity coincided with weak underlying demand. The report questions whether the apparent recovery will hold.
stories.whyItMatters: Telling futures-driven moves apart from genuine spot demand matters for anyone judging whether a price recovery will last.
whatToWatch: Spot market volume and ETF flow data in coming days
Whether futures open interest unwinds or keeps building
questions: What is driving the futures volume: hedging, speculation, or liquidations?

sources.title: Bitcoin flashes false recovery warning as $64 billion futures frenzy masks weak demand

stories.title: Saylor says banks could spark Bitcoin's next rally as Strategy weighs $48 billion credit expansion
stories.summary: Michael Saylor said bank involvement could trigger Bitcoin's next rally. His company, Strategy, is reportedly considering a $48 billion credit expansion. CryptoSlate reported the comments on November 16.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy's large bitcoin holdings and financing moves can shift markets and signal institutional credit appetite for the asset.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of the $48 billion credit expansion plan
Any bank announcements on Bitcoin-related lending
questions: Which banks, if any, are considering this involvement?
How would the credit expansion be structured?

sources.title: Michael Saylor says banks could ignite Bitcoin’s next rally as Strategy eyes $48 billion credit expansion

stories.title: Record hedge-fund leverage could spill over into Bitcoin
stories.summary: Hedge funds have built up record levels of leverage, according to CryptoSlate. Analysts warn this leverage could eventually spread into Bitcoin markets. The report does not give a specific trigger or timeline.
stories.whyItMatters: Leverage in traditional markets can amplify crypto volatility if funds unwind positions or rotate into digital assets.
whatToWatch: Hedge fund positioning data in coming reports
Any sign of deleveraging in traditional markets
questions: What specifically would cause leverage to spill over into Bitcoin?

sources.title: Record hedge-fund leverage could soon spill over into Bitcoin

stories.title: Prediction markets give Jensen Huang just a 14% chance of an Nvidia return this year
stories.summary: Prediction-market odds give Jensen Huang only a 14% chance of returning to Nvidia this year, despite reported backing from Trump. CryptoSlate covered the odds on November 16. The report does not explain why Huang's status at Nvidia is in question.
stories.whyItMatters: Prediction markets increasingly run on crypto infrastructure, so activity on a high-profile contract like this is a gauge of that market's health.
whatToWatch: Any official Nvidia statement on Huang's status
Movement in the prediction-market odds
questions: What prompted questions about Huang leaving or returning to Nvidia?
Which platform is hosting this prediction market?

sources.title: Jensen Huang has just 14% chance of Nvidia return this year despite Trump backing

stories.title: Japan's stalling economy offers Bitcoin no relief from yen funding costs
stories.summary: Japan's economy has stalled, according to CryptoSlate. The slowdown does not appear to be easing yen funding costs, which have weighed on risk assets including Bitcoin. The report ties Japan's macro conditions to crypto market sentiment.
stories.whyItMatters: Yen funding costs affect global carry trades, and shifts there can ripple into Bitcoin and broader risk-asset positioning.
whatToWatch: Bank of Japan policy signals
Yen exchange rate moves against the dollar
questions: What specific funding-cost mechanism links Japan's economy to Bitcoin here?

sources.title: Japan’s economy stalls, giving Bitcoin no automatic relief from yen funding costs

stories.title: Trezor patches wallet spy-chip flaw but warns a new device alone may not fix it
stories.summary: Hardware wallet maker Trezor released a patch for spy chips found in its devices. The company warns that buying a new device may not fully resolve the issue. CryptoSlate reported the fix on November 16.
stories.whyItMatters: Hardware wallet security is central to protecting crypto holdings, so this flaw concerns anyone using Trezor devices for cold storage.
whatToWatch: Trezor's full technical disclosure on the spy chips
Whether further patches or device recalls follow
questions: What steps can users take beyond the patch?

sources.title: Trezor patches crypto wallet spy chips but warns users a new device may not be enough

stories.title: Kava shuts down lending platform after hackers drain nearly $4 million
stories.summary: Kava is shutting down a lending platform after hackers drained almost $4 million from it. CryptoSlate reported the move on November 16. The report does not detail the attack method or any plan for user compensation.
stories.whyItMatters: DeFi lending exploits keep threatening user funds and raise questions about protocol security practices.
whatToWatch: Kava's post-mortem on how the breach happened
Any plan to reimburse affected users
questions: How did the hackers gain access?
Will affected users be made whole?

sources.title: Kava moves to shut down lending platform after hackers drain nearly $4 million

stories.title: Coinone support breach exposes passwords and identity details
stories.summary: South Korean exchange Coinone suffered a breach of its support systems. The breach put user passwords and identity details at risk. CryptoSlate reported the incident on November 16.
stories.whyItMatters: Exchange data breaches expose users to identity theft and account takeover risk beyond any stolen funds.
whatToWatch: Coinone's user notification and remediation steps
Any response from South Korean regulators
questions: Were funds, not just data, at risk?

sources.title: Coinone support breach puts passwords and identity details at risk
